messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: spike detected in prod  - Error rate up ~6% on /v1/chat and tail latency for /v1/embeddings at p99 ~1.8s (baseline 500ms). Started 2026-03-15T10:42:00Z. Dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/prod/requests?span=5m

Maya R: seeing same. A bunch of 5xx from model pool A and queued requests piling on chat.

Tomas V: confirmed. Chat queue depth jumped ~4x at 10:41. Embeddings pods show CPU saturation on quantized nodes.

Chen L: impact profile: chat requests success rate down primarily for long-context sessions (>2k tokens), embeddings slow for batched embed endpoints, rerank still low volume but spike in latency for some customers.

Priya S: customer-impact quick list? Any SLO breaches?

Maya R: SLO alert firing for chat p95 latency and error budget for a couple of orgs on enterprise plans. No full outages but degraded UX.

Tomas V: quick mitigation plan suggestion: 1) tighten per-route global rate limits for non-enterprise tenants 2) reduce per-user concurrency for /v1/chat 3) temporarily lower tokens/min for embeddings for public tier 4) disable rerank for non-critical routes.

Chen L: I'm +1 on doing targeted throttles rather than cluster-wide scale up; we don't have spare GPUs to scale immediately.

Infra Bot: Autopilot suggestions: increase dedicated pool for embeddings (2 nodes) OR apply emergency rate-limit policy via /admin/traffic/mitigate. Estimated rollout time: 2-3m for policy push.

Maya R: Tomas, can you push a quick route-specific quota change? Something like: reduce chat concurrent per-org to 2 (from 10) for orgs tagged tier=free, and embeddings tokens/min to 500 for free tier. Keep enterprise orgs untouched. Also add a global 20% traffic-shed on non-critical rerank route.

Tomas V: On it. Pushing config now. Command I will run:
```bash
curl -X POST https://ops.internal.redwood/mitigate \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"actions":[{"route":"/v1/chat","scope":"org:tags:free","concurrency":2},{"route":"/v1/embeddings","scope":"org:tags:free","tokens_per_min":500},{"route":"/v1/rerank","scope":"global:noncritical","drop_percent":20}]}'
```

Tomas V: pushed, awaiting propagation (config-api reported success).

Infra Bot: Policy applied to gateway layer. 95% propagated to edge nodes.

Maya R: monitoring. Can folks watch dashboards for error rate and queue depth? I'll notify support and product about temporary limits.

Chen L: initial telemetry: chat error rate dropping modestly, queue depth falling. Embeddings p99 latency down ~350ms. Holding.

Priya S: messaging for statuspage? Suggested: "We are applying targeted throttles to non-paid tiers to protect overall system stability. Some free-tier chat and embeddings requests may see reduced throughput and increased throttling. Enterprise customers unaffected." Any objections?

Maya R: good. Post that and add note we'll revisit in 30m.

Tomas V: heads-up — rerank disable caused a small surge of retries from some clients; added 429 -> backoff header to ease retry storms.

Infra Bot: Observability: alert suppression active for non-critical noisy alerts to avoid pages while we stabilize.

Chen L: around 10:58 UTC we see stabilization. Error rate now ~1.2% and tail latencies trending down.

Maya R: planning handoff. I'm stepping off at 11:10 UTC. Tomas, can you take the on-call lead for the next 30m and coordinate with support for any escalations?

Tomas V: taking lead. I'll keep watch and prepare rollback plan if customer impact increases. Current rollback criteria: chat error rate <1% and queue depth within baseline for 10 consecutive minutes -> revert throttles.

Priya S: Support notified, message posted to status page (link: https://status.redwood.statuspage.io/incidents/mitigation-3141592653).

Maya R: leaving handoff notes: 1) throttles target free-tier only 2) enterprise/paid routes untouched 3) rerank still partially disabled for noncritical routes 4) rollback criteria as Tomas stated.

Tomas V: noted. If we need additional mitigation, options: a) temporary model fallback to smaller variant for long-context chat b) emergency capacity from partner pool (billing + ops ok?).

Chen L: I've queued an eval: run synthetic load against chat with current policy to ensure no regression before full rollback.

Infra Bot: synthetic harness scheduled, results ETA 6m.

Maya R: thanks everyone. If anything regresses, page immediately. I'll remain reachable via DMs. :thumbsup:

Tomas V: will do. Monitoring closely.

(automated note) oncall-bot: Incident declared MITIGATION-3141592653. Handoff: Maya -> Tomas. Severity: P1 (degraded).
